inputs.original_text: This is the familiar pattern: leadership debate gets attention, while the underlying choice is to protect the tax advantages of gas companies and property investors rather than seriously consider reform. Angus Taylor shutting down Andrew Hastie’s call says plenty about whose interests the Liberals are prepared to defend. And when asked about the US and Israel’s war with Iran, Taylor would not say whether he supported it or repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump. The public deserves more than a party protecting entrenched wealth at home and staying evasive about military force abroad.
inputs.modified_text: This isn’t just a Liberal leadership spat. It’s about a party choosing to protect tax advantages for gas companies and property investors instead of seriously considering reform—while ordinary people bear the consequences of entrenched wealth. Angus Taylor shutting down Andrew Hastie’s call makes those priorities hard to miss. And on the US and Israel’s war with Iran, Taylor wouldn’t say whether he supported it or repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump. The public deserves leaders who are clear about military force and willing to challenge powerful interests at home.
